systemUpdates.title: System updates
systemUpdates.subtitle: Review the installed release and check the trusted release catalog.
systemUpdates.channelChanged: Check the selected channel to refresh its release status.
systemUpdates.previewChannelWarning: Preview channels may contain unfinished changes. Installation still requires the same verification and explicit approval.
systemUpdates.safeText: Checking never changes the device. Downloading verifies the exact release first, and installation requires a separate administrator approval.
systemUpdates.readOnlyText: Checking reads release metadata only. Installation, downloads and restarts are disabled in this stage.
systemUpdates.metadataMissing: Release metadata is unavailable, so the installed version cannot be compared yet.
systemUpdates.manifestValidated: The release manifest matches the published assets.
systemUpdates.dependenciesText: Packages declared by this release. Nothing is installed during a check.
systemUpdates.artifactsText: Architecture-specific files validated against the catalog manifest.
systemUpdates.unknownError: The update status could not be loaded.
systemUpdates.restartText: The application may be unavailable briefly. A failed health check restores the previous release and database backup automatically.
systemUpdates.confirmText: 3mm will install the reviewed release and restart its services. Do not remove power during the update.
systemUpdates.confirmRestart: I understand that the application will restart and may be briefly unavailable.
systemUpdates.readyMessage: The verified update is ready for administrator approval.
systemUpdates.reconnecting: The update started. Waiting for the application to return…
